I'm a Project Manager with 5+ years of experience managing technology projects from planning through go-live. I've managed 3–10 projects at a time, often with overlapping timelines spanning 3–4 months. Each project had its own scope and level of complexity, some involved a few dozen work items, while others involved hundreds so I was constantly balancing different priorities, deadlines, and moving pieces. I've coordinated cross-functional teams and external partners, managed timelines and dependencies, identified risks, and kept communication clear throughout the project. I enjoy bringing structure to complex work, solving problems as they come up, and finding more efficient ways for teams to work. Through automation, data-driven reporting, and process improvements, I've helped reduce manual tracking by 80% and reporting turnaround by 60%. I'm comfortable working in fast-paced environments where priorities shift and plans need to adapt along the way.
